# Arq Copilot instructions

Use `.zeus/FAST-KERNEL.md` and routed modules. Classify on mode, risk, blast radius and reversibility, not risk alone. Preserve the invariants in `.zeus/INVARIANTS.md`: semantic model, `.arq` safety, geometry, accessibility, security and evidence. Prefer focused checks during edits and full gates only when impact requires them. Report each claim with its evidence state; only `verified` is green.
